interactions_checked.interaction: Ritonavir inhibits CYP3A4, increasing amlodipine exposure ~2‑fold, raising risk of hypotension and edema
interactions_checked.action: Start at half the usual dose (2.5 mg) and monitor blood pressure and peripheral edema

interactions_checked.interaction: Ritonavir increases atorvastatin AUC 2‑3‑fold, increasing myopathy/rhabdomyolysis risk
interactions_checked.action: Start at low dose 20 mg daily; avoid >40 mg; check CK and LFTs at baseline and 12 weeks

interactions_checked.action: Monitor electrolytes and renal function after starting indapamide

treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily to treat stage 2 hypertension per NICE NG136. If BP remains >140/90 mmHg after 4 weeks, add low‑dose amlodipine 2.5 mg daily (adjusted for ritonavir). If still uncontrolled, add indapamide MR 1.5 mg daily. Initiate atorvastatin 20 mg daily for primary CV risk reduction (NICE CG126) with CK/LFT monitoring. Consider metformin 500 mg BID for pre‑diabetes if renal function permits. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, potassium, CK, and lipid profile as outlined. Refer for CPAP and provide lifestyle advice (salt restriction, weight loss, exercise, smoking cessation).
